description: Run a Layers panel menu command: merge layers (Merge Selected), flatten every layer into one (Flatten Artwork), collect items or layers in a new layer (Collect in New Layer), give each object of a layer or group its own sublayer (Release to Layers (Sequence) or (Build)), or reverse the stacking order of layers (Reverse Order)

command.description: merge: the layers into the last one listed. flatten: every top-level layer into layer (default the active layer's top-level layer). collect: target items, or layers, into a new layer. release_sequence: each object of layer (or of one group in target) onto its own new sublayer. release_build: the same, but each new sublayer also holds copies of every object below it, for animation frames. reverse: the order of the layers

hiddenLayers.description: flatten: move the artwork of hidden layers in as hidden objects, or delete those layers. Default include

layer.description: flatten: the layer to flatten into. release_*: the layer whose objects are released

layers.description: merge, reverse, collect: layer names at the same level of the Layers panel

name.description: collect: name of the new layer

target.description: collect: the items to move into a new sublayer of the first item's layer. release_*: one group whose objects are released

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: organize_layers
title: Organize Layers
